1 \#include "kernel_operator.h"

2 \#include "lib/matmul_intf.h"

3

4 using namespace AscendC;

5 using namespace matmul;

6

7 // MLA sparse attention decode: per query row, gather sparse-selected
KV pages

8 // (nope 512 + rope 64 = 576 cols), bmm1(Qjoined x KVg^T) -\> score
float,

9 // softmax -\> P half, bmm2(P x KVg) -\> O bf16. KFC MIX AIC 1:2, AIV
drives cube.

10 constexpr uint32_t SOFTMAX_ROWS = 4;

11 constexpr uint32_t FLOAT_NUM_PER_BLOCK = 8;

12 constexpr uint32_t NOPE_DIM = 512;

13 constexpr uint32_t ROPE_DIM = 64;

14 constexpr uint32_t DQK = NOPE_DIM + ROPE_DIM; // 576

15 constexpr uint32_t N_BATCH = 32; // sparse indices resolved per loop

16 constexpr uint32_t P_MAX = 16; // max KV page rows staged per relay

17

18 using AT1 = MatmulType\<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, bfloat16_t,
false\>; // Qj \[g, 576\]

19 using BT1 = MatmulType\<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, bfloat16_t,
true\>; // KVg \[S2s, 576\] trans

20 using CT1 = MatmulType\<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, float\>; //
score float

21 using AT2 = MatmulType\<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, bfloat16_t,
false\>; // P \[g, S2s\] bf16

22 using BT2 = MatmulType\<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, bfloat16_t,
false\>; // Vg \[S2s, 576\]

23 using CT2 = MatmulType\<TPosition::GM, CubeFormat::ND, bfloat16_t\>;
// out bf16

24

25 // REGIST_MATMUL_OBJ must stay in the extern-C entry scope
(KfcServer/KfcCommClient

26 // locals die on scope exit, killing every AIC server -\> later
IterateAll hangs;

27 // see FlashAttentionScoreWithLargeHeadDim golden).

28 class SparseFlashAttentionKernel {

29 public:

30 \_\_aicore\_\_ inline SparseFlashAttentionKernel() {}

31

32 Matmul\<AT1, BT1, CT1, CT1, CFG_NORM\> bmm1;

33 Matmul\<AT2, BT2, CT2, CT2, CFG_NORM\> bmm2;

34 TPipe pipe\_;

35 uint32_t btStride\_ = 0; // block_table columns per batch (set by
entry)

36

37 \_\_aicore\_\_ inline void Init(

38 GM_ADDR query, GM_ADDR key, GM_ADDR value, GM_ADDR sparse_indices,

39 GM_ADDR block_table, GM_ADDR actual_seq_lengths_query, GM_ADDR
actual_seq_lengths_kv,

40 GM_ADDR query_rope, GM_ADDR key_rope, GM_ADDR attention_out,

41 GM_ADDR workspace, const SparseFlashAttentionTilingData &tilingData)

42 {

43 B\_ = tilingData.batch;

44 S1\_ = tilingData.seqQ;

45 N1\_ = tilingData.numHeadsQ;

46 P\_ = tilingData.blockSize;

47 K\_ = tilingData.sparseBlkCount;

48 gSize\_ = tilingData.gSize;

49 hg\_ = tilingData.hgSplit;

50 nGroups\_ = gSize\_ / hg\_;

51 scale\_ = tilingData.scaleValue;

52 usedCoreNum\_ = tilingData.usedCoreNum;

53 S2s\_ = K\_ \* P\_;

54 nIdxSize\_ = tilingData.nIdxSize;

55 totalTasks\_ = B\_ \* S1\_ \* nGroups\_;

56

57 queryGm\_.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast\<\_\_gm\_\_ bfloat16_t
\*\>(query));

58 keyGm\_.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast\<\_\_gm\_\_ bfloat16_t
\*\>(key));

59 valueGm\_.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast\<\_\_gm\_\_ bfloat16_t
\*\>(value));

60 idxGm\_.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast\<\_\_gm\_\_ int32_t
\*\>(sparse_indices));

61 btGm\_.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast\<\_\_gm\_\_ int32_t
\*\>(block_table));

62 qRopeGm\_.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast\<\_\_gm\_\_ bfloat16_t
\*\>(query_rope));

63 kRopeGm\_.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast\<\_\_gm\_\_ bfloat16_t
\*\>(key_rope));

64 outGm\_.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast\<\_\_gm\_\_ bfloat16_t
\*\>(attention_out));

65

66 // user workspace per block: \[score float \| P bf16 \| KVg
\[S2s,576\] \| Vg \[S2s,512\] \| Qj \[hg,576\]\]

67 scoreSlotElems\_ = static_cast\<uint64_t\>(hg\_) \* S2s\_;

68 pSlotElems\_ = static_cast\<uint64_t\>(hg\_) \* S2s\_;

69 kvSlotBytes\_ = static_cast\<uint64_t\>(S2s\_) \* DQK \*
sizeof(bfloat16_t);

70 vgSlotBytes\_ = static_cast\<uint64_t\>(S2s\_) \* NOPE_DIM \*
sizeof(bfloat16_t);

71 qjSlotBytes\_ = static_cast\<uint64_t\>(hg\_) \* DQK \*
sizeof(bfloat16_t);

72 \_\_gm\_\_ uint8_t \*userWs = GetUserWorkspace(workspace);

73 scoreWsGm\_.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast\<\_\_gm\_\_ float
\*\>(userWs));

74 pWsBase\_ = userWs + scoreSlotElems\_ \* sizeof(float) \*
usedCoreNum\_;

75 kvWsBase\_ = pWsBase\_ + pSlotElems\_ \* sizeof(bfloat16_t) \*
usedCoreNum\_;

76 vgWsBase\_ = kvWsBase\_ + kvSlotBytes\_ \* usedCoreNum\_;

77 qjWsBase\_ = vgWsBase\_ + vgSlotBytes\_ \* usedCoreNum\_;

78

79 softmaxTiling\_ = tilingData.softmaxTiling;

80

81 if (g_coreType == AIV) {

82 // softmax input rows: \[SOFTMAX_ROWS, S2s\] float; output P bf16

83 pipe\_.InitBuffer(scoreTQue\_, 1, SOFTMAX_ROWS \* S2s\_ \*
sizeof(float));

84 pipe\_.InitBuffer(pTQue\_, 1, SOFTMAX_ROWS \* S2s\_ \*
sizeof(bfloat16_t));

85 pipe\_.InitBuffer(pHalfTBuf\_, SOFTMAX_ROWS \* S2s\_ \*
sizeof(half));

86 pipe\_.InitBuffer(pFloatTBuf\_, SOFTMAX_ROWS \* S2s\_ \*
sizeof(float));

87 pipe\_.InitBuffer(sumTBuf\_, SOFTMAX_ROWS \* FLOAT_NUM_PER_BLOCK \*
sizeof(float));

88 pipe\_.InitBuffer(maxTBuf\_, SOFTMAX_ROWS \* FLOAT_NUM_PER_BLOCK \*
sizeof(float));

89 // sparse index staging + gather relay buffer (one KV page, P\*512
bf16)

90 pipe\_.InitBuffer(idxTQue\_, 1, N_BATCH \* sizeof(int32_t));

91 pipe\_.InitBuffer(btTQue\_, 1, N_BATCH \* sizeof(int32_t)); //
block_table row (K selects)

92 pipe\_.InitBuffer(qgTQue\_, 1, P_MAX \* (NOPE_DIM + ROPE_DIM +
NOPE_DIM) \* sizeof(bfloat16_t));

93 }

94 }

95 // AIV sub0 drives gather + bmm1 + softmax + bmm2; sub1 helps softmax

96 \_\_aicore\_\_ inline void Process()

97 {

98 if ASCEND_IS_AIC

99 return;

100 uint32_t subIdx = static_cast\<uint32_t\>(GetBlockIdx() %
GetSubBlockNum());

101 uint32_t blockIdx = static_cast\<uint32_t\>(GetBlockIdx() /
GetSubBlockNum());

102 if (subIdx == 0) {

103 for (uint32_t task = blockIdx; task \< totalTasks\_; task +=
usedCoreNum\_)

104 RunTask(task);

105 bmm1.End();

106 bmm2.End();

107 } else

108 return;

109 }

110 private:

111 // task = (b \* S1 + s1) \* nGroups + hg; hg-th head group of hg\_
joined rows

112 \_\_aicore\_\_ inline void RunTask(uint32_t task)

113 {

114 uint32_t bs = task / nGroups\_;

115 uint32_t hg = task % nGroups\_;

116 uint32_t b = bs / S1\_;

117 uint32_t s1 = bs % S1\_;

118 uint32_t coreId = GetBlockIdx() / GetSubBlockNum();

119

120 GlobalTensor\<float\> scoreGm = scoreWsGm\_\[coreId \*
scoreSlotElems\_\];

121 GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> kvGm;

122 kvGm.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast\<\_\_gm\_\_ bfloat16_t
\*\>(kvWsBase\_ + coreId \* kvSlotBytes\_));

123 GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> vgGm;

124 vgGm.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast\<\_\_gm\_\_ bfloat16_t
\*\>(vgWsBase\_ + coreId \* vgSlotBytes\_));

125 GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> qjGm;

126 qjGm.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast\<\_\_gm\_\_ bfloat16_t
\*\>(qjWsBase\_ + coreId \* qjSlotBytes\_));

127

128 GatherKV(b, s1, kvGm, vgGm); // KVg \[S2s,576\] (K nope+rope) + Vg
\[S2s,512\]

129 BuildJoinedQ(b, s1, hg \* hg\_, qjGm); // Qj \[hg\_,576\] for this
head group

130 qjGm\_ = qjGm;

131

132 // bmm1: Qj \[HG,576\] x KVg^T -\> score float \[HG, S2s\]

133 bmm1.SetSingleShape(static_cast\<int\>(hg\_),
static_cast\<int\>(S2s\_), static_cast\<int\>(DQK));

134 bmm1.SetTensorA(qjGm\_);

135 bmm1.SetTensorB(kvGm, true);

136 bmm1.template IterateAll\<true\>(scoreGm, 0, false, false, false);

137

138 SoftmaxRows(task, 0);

139

140 // bmm2: P \[HG,S2s\] x Vg \[S2s,512\] -\> O bf16 \[HG,512\].

141 // B is the gathered VALUE pages (a separate input tensor from key);

142 // C rows land on output heads \[hg\*HG, hg\*HG+HG) with row stride
512.

143 GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> pGm;

144 pGm.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast\<\_\_gm\_\_ bfloat16_t \*\>(

145 pWsBase\_ + coreId \* pSlotElems\_ \* sizeof(bfloat16_t)));

146 bmm2.SetSingleShape(static_cast\<int\>(hg\_),
static_cast\<int\>(NOPE_DIM), static_cast\<int\>(S2s\_));

147 bmm2.SetTensorA(pGm);

148 bmm2.SetTensorB(vgGm);

149 GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> oGm = outGm\_\[

150 (static_cast\<uint64_t\>(b) \* S1\_ + s1) \* N1\_ \* NOPE_DIM +

151 static_cast\<uint64_t\>(hg) \* hg\_ \* NOPE_DIM\];

152 bmm2.template IterateAll\<true\>(oGm, 0, false, false, false);

153 }

154

155 // GM-\>GM gather relayed through UB (no GM-\>GM DataCopy(Pad)
exists on A2).

156 // GM --MTE2--\> UB (qgTQue\_ VECIN) --MTE3--\> GM using the same
LocalTensor:

157 // UB2GM DataCopyPad accepts any LocalTensor whose HW position is
UB, and

158 // VECIN maps to UB, so the dequeued VECIN tensor is a valid MTE3
source.

159 // Cross-pipeline order via SetFlag/WaitFlag(HardEvent::MTE2_MTE3).

160 // DataCopyExtParams.blockLen is BYTES; srcGap/dstGap are 32B units.

161 // Batch relay: one MTE2 + one MTE3 + one round-trip event per whole
page

162 // instead of per-row relays (profiling iter2: mte2 49% + mte3 33%
of the

163 // single-core time was per-row relay overhead).

164 \_\_aicore\_\_ inline void RelayDrain()

165 {

166 // UB-\>GM write is async on MTE3; before freeing the single-depth

167 // buffer for the next MTE2 reload, drain MTE3 so the next GM-\>UB
copy

168 // cannot overwrite data MTE3 has not yet read out (hot id 216
pattern;

169 // canonical pairing per TPipe::WriteSpmBuffer: MTE3_MTE2 event).

170 TEventID evRet = GetTPipePtr()-\>FetchEventID(HardEvent::MTE3_MTE2);

171 SetFlag\<HardEvent::MTE3_MTE2\>(evRet);

172 WaitFlag\<HardEvent::MTE3_MTE2\>(evRet);

173 GetTPipePtr()-\>ReleaseEventID\<HardEvent::MTE3_MTE2\>(evRet);

174 }

175

176 // Page-batched relay: ONE MTE2 load of nElems contiguous GM elems
into UB,

177 // then per-row 1D MTE3 writes (blockLenBytes each) to scattered dst
rows

178 // (dstRowStrideElems apart). Rationale (iter19-24 evidence): a
single big

179 // MTE3 1D write loses the tail row, and 2D MTE3 dstGap semantics
corrupt

180 // columns -- only small 1D MTE3 writes are reliable; batching the
MTE2

181 // load and the sync events cuts the per-row relay overhead.

182 \_\_aicore\_\_ inline void RelayPage(GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\>
&dstGm, uint64_t dstOff,

183 GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> &srcGm, uint64_t srcBase,

184 uint32_t nElems, uint32_t rows,

185 uint32_t rowElems, uint32_t dstRowStrideElems)

186 {

187 const uint16_t loadLen = static_cast\<uint16_t\>(nElems \*
sizeof(bfloat16_t));

188 const uint16_t lenB = static_cast\<uint16_t\>(rowElems \*
sizeof(bfloat16_t));

189 LocalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> qg = qgTQue\_.AllocTensor\<bfloat16_t\>();

190 DataCopyPad\<bfloat16_t\>(qg, srcGm\[srcBase\],

191 {1, loadLen, loadLen, loadLen, 0},

192 {false, 0, 0, 0});

193 qgTQue\_.EnQue(qg);

194 qg = qgTQue\_.DeQue\<bfloat16_t\>();

195 TEventID ev = GetTPipePtr()-\>FetchEventID(HardEvent::MTE2_MTE3);

196 SetFlag\<HardEvent::MTE2_MTE3\>(ev);

197 WaitFlag\<HardEvent::MTE2_MTE3\>(ev);

198 GetTPipePtr()-\>ReleaseEventID\<HardEvent::MTE2_MTE3\>(ev);

199 for (uint32_t r = 0; r \< rows; r++) {

200 // 1D MTE3 write per row: src UB offset r\*rowElems (contiguous),

201 // dst row r at dstOff + r\*dstRowStrideElems (scattered rows)

202 LocalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> srcView = qg\[r \* rowElems\];

203 DataCopyPad\<bfloat16_t\>(dstGm\[dstOff + static_cast\<uint64_t\>(r)
\* dstRowStrideElems\], srcView, {1, lenB, lenB, lenB, 0});

204 }

205 RelayDrain();

206 qgTQue\_.FreeTensor(qg);

207 }

208

209 // Whole-page triple relay: ONE staging pass for the K nope + rope +
V page

210 // slices of one KV page. Three MTE2 loads land in disjoint offsets
of one

211 // UB buffer (nope \| rope \| V), then a single MTE2_MTE3 event
pair + a

212 // single RelayDrain bracket all per-row 1D MTE3 writes. Replaces 3

213 // independent RelayPage calls (3 event pairs + 3 drains per page);

214 // profiling iter27/28 showed the scalar mte3-stall (event/drain
wait) is

215 // the dominant cost, not the MTE2 bandwidth itself.

216 \_\_aicore\_\_ inline void RelayPageKRV(GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\>
&kvGm, uint64_t dst,

217 GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> &vgGm, uint64_t dstV,

218 uint64_t src, uint64_t srcRope)

219 {

220 constexpr uint32_t NOPE_ELEMS = P_MAX \* NOPE_DIM; // staging offset
of rope

221 constexpr uint32_t V_OFF = P_MAX \* (NOPE_DIM + ROPE_DIM); //
staging offset of V

222 const uint16_t nopeB = static_cast\<uint16_t\>(P\_ \* NOPE_DIM \*
sizeof(bfloat16_t));

223 const uint16_t ropeB = static_cast\<uint16_t\>(P\_ \* ROPE_DIM \*
sizeof(bfloat16_t));

224 const uint16_t rowNB = static_cast\<uint16_t\>(NOPE_DIM \*
sizeof(bfloat16_t));

225 const uint16_t rowRB = static_cast\<uint16_t\>(ROPE_DIM \*
sizeof(bfloat16_t));

226 LocalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> qg = qgTQue\_.AllocTensor\<bfloat16_t\>();

227 DataCopyPad\<bfloat16_t\>(qg, keyGm\_\[src\],

228 {1, nopeB, nopeB, nopeB, 0}, {false, 0, 0, 0});

229 DataCopyPad\<bfloat16_t\>(qg\[NOPE_ELEMS\], kRopeGm\_\[srcRope\],

230 {1, ropeB, ropeB, ropeB, 0}, {false, 0, 0, 0});

231 DataCopyPad\<bfloat16_t\>(qg\[V_OFF\], valueGm\_\[src\],

232 {1, nopeB, nopeB, nopeB, 0}, {false, 0, 0, 0});

233 qgTQue\_.EnQue(qg);

234 qg = qgTQue\_.DeQue\<bfloat16_t\>();

235 TEventID ev = GetTPipePtr()-\>FetchEventID(HardEvent::MTE2_MTE3);

236 SetFlag\<HardEvent::MTE2_MTE3\>(ev);

237 WaitFlag\<HardEvent::MTE2_MTE3\>(ev);

238 GetTPipePtr()-\>ReleaseEventID\<HardEvent::MTE2_MTE3\>(ev);

239 for (uint32_t r = 0; r \< P\_; r++) {

240 DataCopyPad\<bfloat16_t\>(kvGm\[dst + static_cast\<uint64_t\>(r) \*
DQK\],

241 qg\[r \* NOPE_DIM\], {1, rowNB, rowNB, rowNB, 0});

242 DataCopyPad\<bfloat16_t\>(kvGm\[dst + NOPE_DIM +
static_cast\<uint64_t\>(r) \* DQK\],

243 qg\[NOPE_ELEMS + r \* ROPE_DIM\], {1, rowRB, rowRB, rowRB, 0});

244 DataCopyPad\<bfloat16_t\>(vgGm\[dstV + static_cast\<uint64_t\>(r) \*
NOPE_DIM\],

245 qg\[V_OFF + r \* NOPE_DIM\], {1, rowNB, rowNB, rowNB, 0});

246 }

247 RelayDrain();

248 qgTQue\_.FreeTensor(qg);

249 }

250

251 // Gather selected KV pages into KVg \[S2s, 576\] (K nope+rope, for
bmm1)

252 // and Vg \[S2s, 512\] (value nope cols, for bmm2 - value is a
SEPARATE input

253 // tensor, it is NOT shared with key despite V==K dim sizes).

254 // Page ph = block_table\[b, sparse_indices\[b,0,s1,i\]\].

255 \_\_aicore\_\_ inline void GatherKV(uint32_t b, uint32_t s1,

256 GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> &kvGm, GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> &vgGm)

257 {

258 // block_table row for this batch in ONE MTE2 load; per-page scalar

259 // GM reads ( GetValue on GlobalTensor ) each pay full GM latency in

260 // the scalar pipe (profiling iter27: aic_scalar mte2/mte3-stall
heavy).

261 LocalTensor\<int32_t\> btLocal = btTQue\_.AllocTensor\<int32_t\>();

262 DataCopy(btLocal, btGm\_\[static_cast\<uint64_t\>(b) \*
btStride\_\], btStride\_);

263 btTQue\_.EnQue(btLocal);

264 btLocal = btTQue\_.DeQue\<int32_t\>();

265 for (uint32_t base = 0; base \< K\_; base += N_BATCH) {

266 uint32_t n = (K\_ - base \< N_BATCH) ? (K\_ - base) : N_BATCH;

267 // indices layout \[B, N2=1, S1, K\]; TQue EnQue/DeQue gives the

268 // built-in MTE2-\>V sync that PipeBarrier cannot (hot id 182)

269 LocalTensor\<int32_t\> idxLocal =
idxTQue\_.AllocTensor\<int32_t\>();

270 DataCopy(idxLocal, idxGm\_\[(static_cast\<uint64_t\>(b) \* S1\_ +
s1) \* K\_ + base\], n);

271 idxTQue\_.EnQue(idxLocal);

272 idxLocal = idxTQue\_.DeQue\<int32_t\>();

273 for (uint32_t i = 0; i \< n; i++) {

274 int32_t sel = idxLocal.GetValue(i);

275 int32_t ph = btLocal.GetValue(sel);

276 uint64_t src = static_cast\<uint64_t\>(ph) \* P\_ \* NOPE_DIM;

277 uint64_t srcRope = static_cast\<uint64_t\>(ph) \* P\_ \* ROPE_DIM;

278 uint64_t dst = static_cast\<uint64_t\>(base + i) \* P\_ \* DQK;

279 uint64_t dstV = static_cast\<uint64_t\>(base + i) \* P\_ \*
NOPE_DIM;

280 RelayPageKRV(kvGm, dst, vgGm, dstV, src, srcRope);

281 }

282 idxTQue\_.FreeTensor(idxLocal);

283 }

284 btTQue\_.FreeTensor(btLocal);

285 }

286

287 // Joined Q rows: q-head h in \[headOff, headOff + hg\_):

288 // query\[b, s1, h, 0..512) nope + query_rope\[b, s1, h, 0..64)

289 // -\> Qj workspace \[hg\_,576\]. Rows of one head group are
contiguous in both

290 // GM sources -\> two whole-group page relays instead of 2\*hg\_ row
relays

291 // (each row relay paid its own event pair + drain; profiling iter27
showed

292 // scalar mte3-stall dominated the gather phase).

293 \_\_aicore\_\_ inline void BuildJoinedQ(uint32_t b, uint32_t s1,
uint32_t headOff,

294 GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> &qjGm)

295 {

296 uint64_t qo = (static_cast\<uint64_t\>(b) \* S1\_ + s1) \* N1\_ \*
NOPE_DIM +

297 static_cast\<uint64_t\>(headOff) \* NOPE_DIM;

298 uint64_t ro = (static_cast\<uint64_t\>(b) \* S1\_ + s1) \* N1\_ \*
ROPE_DIM +

299 static_cast\<uint64_t\>(headOff) \* ROPE_DIM;

300 RelayPage(qjGm, 0, queryGm\_, qo, hg\_ \* NOPE_DIM, hg\_, NOPE_DIM,
DQK);

301 RelayPage(qjGm, NOPE_DIM, qRopeGm\_, ro, hg\_ \* ROPE_DIM, hg\_,
ROPE_DIM, DQK);

302 }

303

304 // softmax over S2s for the hg\_ joined rows of this head-group task

305 \_\_aicore\_\_ inline void SoftmaxRows(uint32_t task, uint32_t
subIdx)

306 {

307 (void)task;

308 uint32_t coreId = GetBlockIdx() / GetSubBlockNum();

309 GlobalTensor\<float\> scoreGm = scoreWsGm\_\[coreId \*
scoreSlotElems\_\];

310 GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> pGm;

311 pGm.SetGlobalBuffer(reinterpret_cast\<\_\_gm\_\_ bfloat16_t \*\>(

312 pWsBase\_ + coreId \* pSlotElems\_ \* sizeof(bfloat16_t)));

313

314 uint32_t rowBegin = 0, rowEnd = hg\_;

315 (void)subIdx; // sub0 handles all rows serially (see Process())

316 for (uint32_t r = rowBegin; r \< rowEnd; r += SOFTMAX_ROWS) {

317 uint32_t m = (rowEnd - r \< SOFTMAX_ROWS) ? (rowEnd - r) :
SOFTMAX_ROWS;

318 SoftmaxRowBatch(scoreGm, pGm, r, m);

319 }

320 }

321

322 \_\_aicore\_\_ inline void SoftmaxRowBatch(GlobalTensor\<float\>
&scoreGm, GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> &pGm,

323 uint32_t rowBegin, uint32_t m)

324 {

325 LocalTensor\<float\> scoreFLocal =
scoreTQue\_.AllocTensor\<float\>();

326 for (uint32_t i = 0; i \< m; i++) {

327 DataCopy(scoreFLocal\[i \* S2s\_\], scoreGm\[(rowBegin + i) \*
S2s\_\], S2s\_);

328 }

329 scoreTQue\_.EnQue(scoreFLocal);

330 scoreFLocal = scoreTQue\_.DeQue\<float\>();

331 // scale in float, cast to half for SoftMax (bf16 src unsupported),
then

332 // half -\> float -\> bf16 two-step relay (no direct half-\>bf16
Cast on

333 // dav_c220; bf16 dst only accepts float src) so bmm2 A/B are both
bf16.

334 LocalTensor\<half\> pHalfLocal = pHalfTBuf\_.Get\<half\>();

335 Muls(scoreFLocal, scoreFLocal, scale\_, m \* S2s\_);

336 Cast(pHalfLocal, scoreFLocal, RoundMode::CAST_RINT, m \* S2s\_);

337 scoreTQue\_.FreeTensor(scoreFLocal);

338

339 LocalTensor\<float\> sumLocal = sumTBuf\_.Get\<float\>();

340 LocalTensor\<float\> maxLocal = maxTBuf\_.Get\<float\>();

341 SoftMaxShapeInfo shapeInfo{m, S2s\_, m, S2s\_};

342 SoftMax\<half, false\>(pHalfLocal, sumLocal, maxLocal, pHalfLocal,
softmaxTiling\_, shapeInfo);

343 LocalTensor\<float\> pFloatLocal = pFloatTBuf\_.Get\<float\>();

344 Cast(pFloatLocal, pHalfLocal, RoundMode::CAST_NONE, m \* S2s\_);

345 LocalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> pLocal =
pTQue\_.AllocTensor\<bfloat16_t\>();

346 // CAST_NONE float-\>bf16 is rejected by dav_c220 (assert compiles
to a

347 // silent skip in release) leaving stale UB data in dst - must use
an

348 // explicit rounding mode.

349 Cast(pLocal, pFloatLocal, RoundMode::CAST_RINT, m \* S2s\_);

350 pTQue\_.EnQue(pLocal);

351 pLocal = pTQue\_.DeQue\<bfloat16_t\>();

352 for (uint32_t i = 0; i \< m; i++) {

353 DataCopy(pGm\[(rowBegin + i) \* S2s\_\], pLocal\[i \* S2s\_\],
S2s\_);

354 }

355 pTQue\_.FreeTensor(pLocal);

356 }

357

358 TQue\<TPosition::VECIN, 1\> scoreTQue\_;

359 TQue\<TPosition::VECOUT, 1\> pTQue\_;

360 TBuf\<TPosition::VECCALC\> pHalfTBuf\_;

361 TBuf\<TPosition::VECCALC\> pFloatTBuf\_;

362 TBuf\<TPosition::VECCALC\> sumTBuf\_;

363 TBuf\<TPosition::VECCALC\> maxTBuf\_;

364 TQue\<TPosition::VECIN, 1\> idxTQue\_;

365 TQue\<TPosition::VECIN, 1\> btTQue\_;

366 TQue\<TPosition::VECIN, 1\> qgTQue\_;

367 GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> queryGm\_, keyGm\_, valueGm\_, qRopeGm\_,
kRopeGm\_, outGm\_;

368 GlobalTensor\<bfloat16_t\> qjGm\_;

369 GlobalTensor\<int32_t\> idxGm\_, btGm\_;

370 GlobalTensor\<float\> scoreWsGm\_;

371 \_\_gm\_\_ uint8_t \*pWsBase\_ = nullptr;

372 \_\_gm\_\_ uint8_t \*kvWsBase\_ = nullptr;

373 \_\_gm\_\_ uint8_t \*vgWsBase\_ = nullptr;

374 \_\_gm\_\_ uint8_t \*qjWsBase\_ = nullptr;

375 SoftMaxTiling softmaxTiling\_;

376 uint32_t B\_ = 0, S1\_ = 0, N1\_ = 0, P\_ = 0, K\_ = 0, gSize\_ = 0,
hg\_ = 0, nGroups\_ = 0;

377 uint32_t S2s\_ = 0, usedCoreNum\_ = 0, nIdxSize\_ = 0, totalTasks\_
= 0;

378 float scale\_ = 1.0f;

379 uint64_t scoreSlotElems\_ = 0, pSlotElems\_ = 0, kvSlotBytes\_ = 0,
vgSlotBytes\_ = 0, qjSlotBytes\_ = 0;

380 };

381

382 extern "C" \_\_global\_\_ \_\_aicore\_\_ void
sparse_flash_attention(

383 GM_ADDR query, GM_ADDR key, GM_ADDR value, GM_ADDR sparse_indices,

384 GM_ADDR block_table, GM_ADDR actual_seq_lengths_query, GM_ADDR
actual_seq_lengths_kv,

385 GM_ADDR query_rope, GM_ADDR key_rope, GM_ADDR attention_out,

386 GM_ADDR workspace, GM_ADDR tiling)

387 {

388 GET_TILING_DATA(tilingData, tiling);

389 // MIX AIC 1:2: N=AIC servers + 2N AIV; vector drives cube via KFC

390 KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_2);

391 uint32_t blk = static_cast\<uint32_t\>(GetBlockIdx());

392 uint32_t sub = static_cast\<uint32_t\>(GetSubBlockNum());

393 if (blk \>= tilingData.usedCoreNum \* sub)

394 return;

395 set_mask_norm();

396 SparseFlashAttentionKernel op;

397 op.btStride\_ = tilingData.sparseBlkCount; // max blocks per batch
== selects

398 REGIST_MATMUL_OBJ(&op.pipe\_, GetSysWorkSpacePtr(), op.bmm1,
&tilingData.cubeTiling1,

399 op.bmm2, &tilingData.cubeTiling2);

400 op.Init(query, key, value, sparse_indices, block_table,
actual_seq_lengths_query,

401 actual_seq_lengths_kv, query_rope, key_rope, attention_out,
workspace, tilingData);

402 op.Process();

403 }
